title: Functional study of three cases with novel TBX19 variants.
authors: Lei, NokI; Qiu, Xiang; Li, Wunying; Liu, Yanlin; Hu, Ronggui; Li, Chuanyin; Lu, Wenli
one_liner_zh: 该文研究TBX19变异导致先天性孤立性ACTH缺乏症，虽用AlphaFold3和致病性预测算法分析蛋白结构，但核心是临床变异功能验证，非TF-DNA结合互作建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: PURPOSE: Congenital isolated adrenocorticotropic hormone deficiency (CIAD) is an autosomal recessive disorder. This study identifies novel TBX19 variants for CIAD patients, explores its possible effect mechanism at the structural, functional and protein levels, and guides clinicians better understand the condition. METHODS: The clinical characteristics of three CIAD children were summarized. Multiple sequence alignment was performed and five algorithms, PROVEA, PolyPhen2, Mutation Taster, FATHMM, and I Mutant2.0, were used for the pathogenicity prediction. In addition, the three-dimensional protein structure of wild-type TBX19 was generated by Alphafold 3 and its variants were shown using PyMOL. Furthermore, immunoblotting analysis was applied to examine changes in the protein levels and the luciferase reporter assay was performed to further investigate the effects of TBX19 and its variants on pro-opiomelanocortin (POMC) transcriptional activity. RESULTS: We describe three Chinese patients with CIAD caused by TBX19 variants. The TBX19 variant, c.856C>T (p.R286*) was classified as pathogenic according to ACMG, whereas the other four variants, c.377C>T (p.P126L), c.602A>T (p.E201V), c.401A>G (p.H134R) and c.299G>A (p.R100H) were predicted to be disease-causing. Variants lead to alter interactions, conformational changes in proteins or truncate protein. TBX19 and PITX1 cooperated, resulting in a strong synergistic activation effect on POMC transcriptional expression. A functional study showed that the variants in our study result in a significant suppression of POMC transcriptional activity compared to wild-type TBX19. CONCLUSIONS: Our study identifies five TBX19 loss-of-function variants, two of which are novel and that provides new perspectives into the pathophysiological mechanism and expands the variant spectrum in IAD.
abstract_zh: 目的：先天性孤立性促肾上腺皮质激素缺乏症（CIAD）是一种常染色体隐性遗传病。本研究旨在识别CIAD患者中新的TBX19变异，探讨其在结构、功能和蛋白质水平上的可能作用机制，并帮助临床医生更好地理解该疾病。方法：总结了三例CIAD患儿的临床特征。进行了多序列比对，并使用五种算法（PROVEA、PolyPhen2、Mutation Taster、FATHMM和I Mutant2.0）进行致病性预测。此外，利用Alphafold 3生成了野生型TBX19的三维蛋白质结构，并使用PyMOL展示其变异体。进一步，应用免疫印迹分析检测蛋白质水平的变化，并通过荧光素酶报告基因实验研究TBX19及其变异体对前阿黑皮素原（POMC）转录活性的影响。结果：我们描述了由TBX19变异引起的三例中国CIAD患者。根据ACMG标准，TBX19变异c.856C>T（p.R286*）被归类为致病性，而其他四个变异c.377C>T（p.P126L）、c.602A>T（p.E201V）、c.401A>G（p.H134R）和c.299G>A（p.R100H）被预测为致病性。这些变异导致相互作用改变、蛋白质构象变化或蛋白质截短。TBX19和PITX1协同作用，对POMC转录表达产生强烈的协同激活效应。功能研究表明，与野生型TBX19相比，本研究中的变异导致POMC转录活性显著抑制。结论：我们的研究识别了五个TBX19功能丧失变异，其中两个为新变异，这为IAD的病理生理机制提供了新视角，并扩展了其变异谱。
